ownership_reason: Only the gold builds the cache key and reads the date/time formatter cache (a private field of DateUtils, out of reach of the facade and the other hops). Once the key ignores the locale, a request for one locale is served the formatter cached for another: earlier hops cannot pre-filter it (the key drops whatever locale they pass, and the styles and time zone cannot carry it) and later hops receive only the formatter, so they can recover only by creating a second one. The sibling factories key their caches by the locale: getDateInstance adds the resolved locale to its key, getTimeInstance adds the given locale, and getInstance keys its cache by a shell whose equals compares the locale; test_changeDefault_Locale_DateInstance asserts the identical expectations through getDateInstance and testShortDateStyleWithLocales expects two locales of one style to give two formatters.
